meta.description:
Schlüter Ditra Matting The Schlüter-DITRA matting is a polypropylene membrane featuring square dovetailed recesses imprinted with EasyCut guidelines and an EasyFill design. DITRA provides waterproofing, vapour pressure equalisation (for underside moistures) and uncoupling (for problematic substrates) when used in conjunction with tile coverings.
Key features:

Fleece fabric laminated on the underside.
Uncouples the covering from the substrate, neutralising stresses between the substrate and the tile covering.
The adhesive-filled square recesses provide load distribution, transferring mechanical stress directly to the substrate for added durability.
Protects the sub-structure from damage caused by permeating moisture or aggressive substrates thanks to its waterproofing properties and high-water vapour diffusion seal.
Air channels, that remain open on the underside, enabling vapour pressure equalisation in case of moisture impact from below.

result.description:
Industrial metals are a great finishing touch to your tiled space, creating a raw edge to a minimalist aesthetic. Made of solid copper with a tarnished, rustic finish, this Foundry metal trim is protected with a matt lacquer and can be maintained with just soap and water. This innovative surface finish means the metal won’t be affected by the environment allowing you to use it anywhere in the home.

Available in a 2.5m straight edge strip in two sizes, 10mm and 12.5mm.

When placing the product, ensure it does not come into contact with the tile adhesive or grout. If contact is made, wipe down straight away using clean water and then dry with a lint-free cloth.

Avoid contact with trowels, steel wool and other metal items to prevent scrapes and scratches.

Copper profiles can be mitred if using for window frames, part-tiled walls, external corners, and surrounding splashbacks.Ensure care is taken around cut edges of the trim to prevent injury during installation.

Do not use any cement stain removers or chemically active cleaning products when wiping down the product's surface.

result.name: Zellica™ Taupe Tile (6cm x 24cm)

media.alt_text: Zellica™ Taupe Tile fitted on bathroom wall with hanging plant and round mirror.
Zellica™ Taupe Gloss Tile fitted on kitchen wall.

result.tile_care:
In some cases polished porcelain will have a transit wax on the tile surface to prevent scratching during transportation. This transit will need to be removed using Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover before grouting.
Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover.

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer’s instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Working in small areas of 1m², spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover.

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 in clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Using a green emulsifying pad work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner. Always perform a test in a small portion of the surface to verify the acid resistance of the surface.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover.

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer.

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any dry residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

Inspired by the famous majolica pottery, the Zellica™ tile brings a traditional Spanish feel to contemporary décor. The range uses innovative technology to mimic the typical high gloss finish of classic majolica. Each piece is fired at a specific temperature and a slower speed to achieve the characteristic ultra glossy look. This glaze doesn't quite reach the tiles' edges, giving them a textured finish and a handcrafted appearance, as well as a natural variation in colour. In a rustic taupe shade, this warm toned tile captures the spirit of the 18th century interpretation of zellige tiling.

result.tile_care:
Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.

For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)

For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.

Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

result.name: Elegant Black Splashback (59.8cm x 75cm)
result.tile_care:
Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.

For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)

For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.

Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.

For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)

For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.

Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

The Crisp range mimics the look of these marble chips with a colourful contemporary twist on a durable porcelain tile. Crisp White features specs of blue, brown and grey for a calming take on modern abstract pattern whilst its larger size offers a seamless flow of uninterrupted pattern across the wall or floor. 

This matt finished tile pairs perfectly with oceanic tones, rustic wood grains and fresh greenery for a bright aesthetic.

result.name: Rivona™ White Tile (30cm x 60cm)

media.alt_text: Rivona™ White Tile fitted on bathroom wall with round mirror and floor plant.

result.tile_care:
With highly textured surfaces the use of BAL Protective Sealer may be required. Please ask in store for more details.

Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.
For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.
A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

result.name: Astoria Beige Tile (59.2cm x 59.2cm)

media.alt_text: Astoria Beige terrazzo effect tile fitted on bathroom wall.
Astoria Beige terrazzo effect tile fitted on shower wall.

result.tile_care:
Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.

For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)

For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.

Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

This hardy porcelain replica features a sugar glaze for a semi-polished finish with a lustrous sparkle running through it.

Portland’s mottled surface print and neutral colour palette offers a natural take on the popular abstract terrazzo finishes. This classic white shade is synonymous with traditional terrazzo that paves the streets of Italian cities.

Featuring rectified edges, this tile has straight cut edges allowing you to use a narrower grout joint for a seamless finish, use it on the wall or floor in your home for a striking finish.

result.name: Portland Grey Tile (29.7cm x 59.7cm)

media.alt_text: Portland Grey Tile fitted on bathroom wall with wooden basin unit and white bathtub.

result.tile_care:
Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.

For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)

For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.

Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.

Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

With highly textured surfaces the use of BAL Protective Sealer may be required. Please ask in store for more details.

Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.
For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.
A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

result.description:
Inspired by the Spanish word for more and the idea of doing more with less, Mas is a champion of sustainability.

Mas Grey has over 98% recycled content, and thanks to its patented manufacturing method it uses 44% less water during production and produces only 5.95KG of carbon per square metre, offering a 51% reduction in CO2.

This unique wall and floor tile utilises a low energy dry granulation process, which avoids spray drying the tiles, and is then pressed for consistency offering a full-bodied tile (where its colour runs all the way through the tile).

This unglazed rectangular ceramic tile has the earthy, handmade appearance of quarry tiles, thanks to its matt, textured surface finish and muted neutral colour palette. Suitable for both indoor and out, with a high slip resistance rating for added safety, Mas is the perfect choice for a rustic country kitchen and alfresco dining.

result.description: Marrying the beauty of Carrara marble with the practicality of porcelain, Wiven features a soft dappled veining with a smooth satin finish for a subtle touch of luxe. Use this marble effect tile on the wall or the floor for a stunning and timeless finish.

result.name: Wiven™ Carrara Satin Tile (60cm x 120cm)
result.tile_care:
Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.

For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)

For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.

Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

result.description:
Achieve the beauty of limestone flagstones without the maintenance. Henlow mimics the rustic nature of Burgundy’s famous flagstone with a subtle relief in the surface texture using 4D printing technology. It’s sculpted, handcrafted edges are digitally printed for an ultra-realistic finish on a hardy porcelain base. This 60x90cm tile can be used on the wall and floor, inside and out.
 
Lean into the traditional finish of Henlow’s rustic, weathered effect with the classic warm toned beige that flagstones are known for. It provides the perfect foundation for minimalist of maximalist schemes, pairing with both neutral and bolder colour palettes.

Recycled content used: 41%

meta.title: Elko Cross Cut Grey Tile (30cm x 60cm) | Topps Tiles

result.short_description: Using the latest 4D glazing technology, the Elko range expertly replicates real travertine stone by building layers of glaze in the manufacturing process to create authentic looking texture and veining of real stone...
result.description:
Using the latest 4D glazing technology, the Elko range expertly replicates real travertine stone by building layers of glaze in the manufacturing process to create authentic looking texture and veining of real stone. Elko’s stone effect print is then placed on top, marrying texture with pattern, and in this case, a crosscut design which is a softer version of travertine with mottled subtle detailing.

Thanks to the tile’s clean cut (rectified) edges, you can create a mixed design with the alternative vein cut design, which forms a linear looking veining on the tile surface. Suitable for both wall and floor, the Elko’s neutral colour palette closely replicates the natural variation of real travertine.

Recycled Content Used: 39%

For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.

For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)

For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.

Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

breadcrumbs.label: Petrol Blue/Warm Grey Reversible Aluminium Splashback (75cm x 90cm)

result.product_name_2: Petrol Blue/Warm Grey Reversible Aluminium Splashback (75cm x 90cm)
result.tile_care:
AluSplash splashbacks are vigorously tested for various aspects of functionality and durability. However, like most wall surfaces it is vital that the splashbacks be cared for and maintained correctly to ensure that the splashbacks retains its aesthetic look, colour, gloss and surface finish. Failure to comply with these guidelines will result in the product’s warranty being void:

  1. Ensure that a minimum setback distance of 30mm or 1.18” is maintained between the installed AluSplash splashback and the edge of the cooktop
  2. Do not clean the splashback surface if it is hot! Wait for the surface to cool to room temperature before cleaning
  3. Ensure that steam from cooking or a kettle is not directly facing the splashback surface. The hot steam, air and/or boiling water released can cause the surface of the splashback to be stained or damaged.
  4. Do not allow the flame from the gas cooktop to spread up the sides of the cooking pot or pan
  5. Avoid placing metallic or sharp objects like knives and other utensils against the coated surface, as it may cause scratches on the splashbacks surface
  6. The splashback surface must be cleaned regularly, using only a soft microfiber cloth or a non-abrasive cloth. You can clean the splashback surface with water, and for stubborn stains, you may use a mild detergent
  7. Do not use acidic, caustic or abrasive cleaning detergents or materials to clean the splashback surface
  8. Detergents with bleach or home remedy solutions such as baking soda, or other stain removing gels, powders, liquids or materials should not be used on the splashback surface
  9. AluSplash recommends using a low modulus neutral cure silicone or similar, as well as using 3M VHB double-sided tape or similar for the installation of the splashbacks
  10. It is recommended that all AluSplash splashbacks should be cleaned with FILA Multi Surface Cleaner 1ltr.
  11. Alusplash splashbacks have a 5-year limited liability warranty when installed in accordance with the manufacturers' fabrication and installation guidelines.

result.description:
BAL Bedding Mortar is a special cement with graded fillers for producing a high performance mortar bed for external use, allowing external pavers and tiles to be fixed to the requirements of BS 7533-4. Bed depth can be achieved from 10mm up to 100mm thickness (minimum 25mm on MOT Type 1).

Pre-blended – just add water, BAL Bedding Mortar is easy to mix and lay up to 100mm in a single application. With more than 1hr working time and walkable in 12 hours it provides the perfect bedding system for 20mm porcelain, stone and pavers. It is also freeze-thaw resistant – protecting external installations against damage. Suitable on both bonded and unbonded backgrounds including concrete and Type 1 MOT.

result.description:
Rubi diamond profiles for rounding are suitable for dry cutting with any angle grinder that supports the M14 thread connection. These diamond profiling bits create bevels for skirting boards, countertops and steps as well as swimming pool crowns and are suitable for use on natural stone and landscaping materials up to 20mm thick. This bit is designed to create a full bullnosed edge where the curved edge is created on both the top and the bottom of the surface.

The high-quality diamond particles adhere to the body of the bur and present a high resistance to friction and temperature thanks to Rubi’s vacuum brazing technology. To obtain the best performance and finish it is recommended to use a grinder with a speed between 6,000 and 8,000 rpm.

result.name: Everscape™ Langton Grey Outdoor Tile (80cm x 80cm)

breadcrumbs.label: Everscape™ Langton Grey Outdoor Tile (80cm x 80cm)

result.tile_care:
Everscape is a range of 20mm Porcelain tiles, which will require regular care and maintenance to retain that showroom finish. The specific initial cleaning requirement will depend on the fitting method used and choice of grouting options.

When fixing with Tile Adhesive and finishing with Micromax3 grouts:

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: Wait approximately 10 to 30 minutes after grouting and working in small areas, spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean the surface using a damp sponge. For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat this process.

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover 1:5 with clean water (1 litre Residue Remover with 5 litres water). Spread the solution over the surface with a cloth and leave to act for 5 minutes. Wipe up any residues and rinse thoroughly with clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue. This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner. Always perform a test in a small portion of the surface to verify the acid resistance of the surface.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute Fila Multi Surface Cleaner 1:200 with clean water (3 capfuls with 5 litres water). Clean the tile surface using a cloth or mop. There is no need to rinse after cleaning as no residues are left on the surface.

For more stubborn dirt, dilute Fila Multi Surface Cleaner 1:30 with clean water. Spread the solution evenly across the surface and leave to act for 5 minutes. Clean across the surface using a brush and rinse off with plenty of clean water

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer.

Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any remaining residues on the surface can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.


Any dry residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

result.description:
Outdoor tiles to make the most of every day.

Extend your style outside and learn to love your garden all year round! From sun drenched patios and secret courtyard gardens to cosy city balconies and breezy beachfront terraces, our exclusive range of outdoor tiles will help transform every corner of your home into spaces you’ll never want to leave, creating the perfect space for endless summers.

Everscape is a range of specialised 2cm deep outdoor tiles with an amalgamation of ‘forever’ and ‘landscape’ embodied in its spirit. This combination of elegant, simple design married with innovative technology allows you to make a real investment in your outdoor space for years to come.

It's hardwearing porcelain meaning little upkeep is needed and with multiple ways to fit it, it’s an easy DIY solution for the budding landscape designer in all of us. The 2cm depth coupled with the slip resistant surface provides ultimate durability and safety all year round.

Produced with ‘anti-slip soft technology’ this stunning outdoor tile, Langton, mimics the look of stone with its delicate veining but feels smooth to the touch whilst still offering exceptional slip resistance for all weather. Its earthy colour palette complements its natural surroundings to minimise the harsh appearance of hard landscaping. 

Key Product Features:

  • Variety of sizes and formats available
  • 2cm depth 
  • High slip resistance
  • Nonporous so tiles won’t ‘pop’ or crack in freezing temperatures
  • No specialist sealing or cleaning required
  • Suitable for use with a pressure washer
  • Multiple fitting solutions available
  • A range of complementary finishing accessories are available

Complete your Everscape tiling project with our one-stop shop for outdoor tiling. Choose from our range of outdoor adhesives, leveller, pedestals systems, outdoor suitable grouts, finishing trims as well as outdoor tools and cutters. And once your project is complete, help maintain your finished patio with the Fila Outdoor Patio Cleaner.

Fitting the Everscape range yourself? Check out the fitting guides on our Knowledge Base for some useful tips for laying on grass, gravel, cement, and pedestals.

The backing foam is composed of 20% recycled content, made from plastic bottles, and provides up to 60% noise reduction (when fitted to a substrate). For a quick DIY solution, these wood panels can also be glued to the wall, offering 25% in noise reduction.

Slat size - 2.7cm x 1.3cm

Slats Per Panel - 15

To find out more information, view our How To Install Wood Wall Panels Guide.

Please note this product is not suitable for bathrooms.

Due to the natural characteristics of wood veneer, these acoustic wood wall panels may experience a slight colour change over time if exposed to direct sunlight.

 Fire Resistant Class: D-s2, d0

result.name: Kanvas™ White Tile (4.8cm x 45cm)
result.tile_care:
Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.

For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)

For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.

Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.

Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

meta.title: FILA LVT & Laminate Cleaner | Topps Tiles

result.description:
When taking care of your home it’s important to choose the right products for the right surfaces. Fila’s specialist LVT and Laminate cleaner has been specifically designed to work with the finish on these flooring types. 

General household cleaners are usually aggressive and can damage the flooring’s wear layer over time, with their polymers not evaporating in water creating a film on the floor’s surface, making it look dirty quicker. Fila’s specialist cleaner cleans and degreases all LVT and laminate surfaces with a streak and residue free finish, ideal for everyday maintenance.

You can even dilute this solution with water in a spray bottle and use it around the rest of your home.

result.description:
Light and compact, the Rubi RV-18 Energy vibrates the tile’s surface to avoid the creation of air bubbles between the substrate and tile, the vibration frequency can be easily adjusted between 0 and 10,000 rpm. Its ergonomic handle and wireless design provide comfort and control whilst the tool is in use, making it ideal for vertical supports and working at heights (weighing only 1.2KG including battery).

The RV-18 Energy features a built-in suction cup with a maximum load capacity of 50KG on smooth surfaces (only). This allows the user to combat any error and recover the tile’s position quickly and easily.

Powered by an 18V 2Ah Lithium-ion battery, which is included, as well as a carrying case and charger. You can also purchase a separate Rubi 18v Battery.

This classic looking tile has been given a contemporary update thanks to its sleek rectified edge, providing the ability to tile as little as 3mm apart, and its versatile muted colour palette. You can even mix and match the colours across the Tanjin range to create your own unique pattern.

To achieve the best results, we recommend a minimum grout joint of 3mm.

result.name: Tanjin™ Olive Tile (10.7cm x 10.7cm)
result.tile_care:
Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.

For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)

For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.

Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

meta.title: BAL Level Plus Grey 20kg | Topps Tiles

result.description:
BAL Level Plus is a rapid-setting, smoothing and levelling compound that gives you two ways to work. Use it as a standard one-part compound mixed with clean water, or combine it with BAL Level Plus Liquid Latex for a high-performance, two-part solution that adds flexibility and moisture tolerance. In its one-part form, BAL Level Plus can be applied from 2mm to 12mm over common substrates like concrete, sand and cement screeds, anhydrite, and areas with old adhesive residue. When mixed with BAL Liquid Latex, it becomes a two-part system suitable for more demanding substrates. Use it from 2mm to 10mm over bitumen, flooring-grade asphalt, glazed tiles, vinyl (excluding LVT), underfloor heating systems and damp-proof membranes.

Both options offer a 25-minute pot life and can be tiled over in as little as 2 to 3 hours. For deeper areas, BAL Level Plus can be built up to 30mm when mixed with aggregate.
result.shelf_life: 12 months under normal dry conditions. Protect from frost and damp.

result.name: Zellica™ Flute Ink Blue Tile (6cm x 24cm)

breadcrumbs.label: Zellica™ Flute Ink Blue Tile (6cm x 24cm)

result.tile_care:
In some cases polished porcelain will have a transit wax on the tile surface to prevent scratching during transportation. This transit will need to be removed using Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover before grouting.
Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover.

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer’s instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Working in small areas of 1m², spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover.

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 in clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Using a green emulsifying pad work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner. Always perform a test in a small portion of the surface to verify the acid resistance of the surface.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover.

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer.

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any dry residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

breadcrumbs.label: Everscape™ Belgian Blue Outdoor Tile (60cm x 60cm)

media.alt_text: Everscape™ Belgian Blue Outdoor Tile fitted on garden floor.

result.tile_care:
Everscape is a range of 20mm Porcelain tiles, which will require regular care and maintenance to retain that showroom finish. The specific initial cleaning requirement will depend on the fitting method used and choice of grouting options.

When fixing with Tile Adhesive and finishing with Micromax3 grouts:

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: Wait approximately 10 to 30 minutes after grouting and working in small areas, spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean the surface using a damp sponge. For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat this process.

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover 1:5 with clean water (1 litre Residue Remover with 5 litres water). Spread the solution over the surface with a cloth and leave to act for 5 minutes. Wipe up any residues and rinse thoroughly with clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue. This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner. Always perform a test in a small portion of the surface to verify the acid resistance of the surface.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute Fila Multi Surface Cleaner 1:200 with clean water (3 capfuls with 5 litres water). Clean the tile surface using a cloth or mop. There is no need to rinse after cleaning as no residues are left on the surface.

For more stubborn dirt, dilute Fila Multi Surface Cleaner 1:30 with clean water. Spread the solution evenly across the surface and leave to act for 5 minutes. Clean across the surface using a brush and rinse off with plenty of clean water

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer.

Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any remaining residues on the surface can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.


Any dry residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

result.description:
Outdoor tiles to make the most of every day.

Extend your style outside and learn to love your garden all year round! From sun drenched patios and secret courtyard gardens to cosy city balconies and breezy beachfront terraces, our exclusive range of outdoor tiles will help transform every corner of your home into spaces you’ll never want to leave, creating the perfect space for endless summers.

Everscape is a range of specialised 2cm deep outdoor tiles with an amalgamation of ‘forever’ and ‘landscape’ embodied in its spirit. This combination of elegant, simple design married with innovative technology allows you to make a real investment in your outdoor space for years to come.

It's hardwearing Porcelain meaning little upkeep is needed and with multiple ways to fit it, it’s an easy DIY solution for the budding landscape designer in all of us. The 2cm depth coupled with the slip resistant surface provides ultimate durability and safety all year round. 

Everscape Belgian Blue brings a refined look to outdoor spaces. The rich tone and smooth surface help create a calm and structured layout, which works well across open patios or in more focused areas like pathways and seating zones. The finish has a quiet elegance that complements planting, timber and clean-lined garden features.

Key Product Features:

  •  Variety of sizes and formats available
  • 2cm depth
  • Nonporous so tiles won’t ‘pop’ or crack in freezing temperatures
  • No specialist sealing or cleaning required
  • Suitable for use with a pressure washer
  • Multiple fitting solutions available
  •  A range of complementary finishing accessories are available

Complete your Everscape tiling project with our one-stop shop for outdoor tiling. Choose from our range of outdoor adhesives, leveller, pedestals systems, outdoor suitable grouts, finishing trims as well as outdoor tools and cutters. And once your project is complete, help maintain your finished patio with the Fila Outdoor Patio Cleaner.

Fitting the Everscape range yourself? Check out the fitting guides on our Knowledge Base for some useful tips for laying on grass, gravel, cement, and pedestals.

result.description:
Slim and architectural in feel, Picket is a mosaic wall tile made from a considered blend of natural stone and glass. The picket shape has an easy vertical or horizontal flow that introduces height or gentle width to a space, while the textured surface gives depth you can see and feel.

The mixed-material composition is the point. Stone adds weight and texture, glass brings reflection and clarity, and together they create a surface that feels more layered than a single material could. 

We recommend the use of a 2mm grout joint and white adhesive to preserve the true colour of the glass and keep the blend even across the wall.

Spectrum has an intricate, almost handcrafted quality, with small glass squares arranged in a precise grid. The soft iridescent finish and textured surface catch and reflect light, creating a gentle shift in tone that evolves with changing daylight.

result.name: Arno Oval Ivory Mosaic Tile
result.tile_care:
Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.

For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)

For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.

Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.

For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)

For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.

Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

The extra-large format and rectified edges allow for minimal grout lines, creating openness and a seamless flow that's easier to keep clean. Suitable for both indoor and outdoor use, this versatile tile carries the same serene palette throughout the home, linking interiors and garden spaces. The durable porcelain construction delivers the travertine look with simpler maintenance, handling moisture and temperature changes with ease.

For best results, fit with a powder-based adhesive suitable for porcelain, use a minimum 3mm grout joint, and we recommend finishing edges with a trim at least 10mm deep to accommodate the 8mm tile thickness.

meta.title: Kerakoll Prime Plus 1ltr | Topps Tiles

result.description:
Kerakoll Primeplus is a reliable primer for preparing absorbent substrates before applying tile adhesives, smoothing compounds or levellers. Designed to stabilise and seal the surface, it helps create a consistent base so the next layer bonds securely. Suitable for both internal and external use, it’s a practical choice for everyday installation work.

Apply Prime Plus only when the substrate temperature is above 5°C, and ensure any underfloor heating is switched off for at least 24 hours beforehand. Once applied, it dries to form a supportive surface that improves adhesion and helps reduce issues caused by uneven porosity across the substrate.

Coverage:

  • 1 l applied neat ≈ 10 m2
  • 1 l diluted with 3 parts water ≈ 40 m2
  • 1 l applied as a slurry coat ≈ 18 m2

meta.title: Kerakoll Prime+Grip 1ltr | Topps Tiles

result.description:
Kerakoll Prime+ Grip is a priming and bonding agent, primarily designed for non-porous substrates where adhesion is typically more challenging, including existing ceramic, porcelain and natural stone tiles, as well as floor grade asphalt, bitumen and steel. It creates a grippy surface that helps tile adhesives and levelling compounds key in securely.

Shake Prime+ Grip well before use to ensure the aggregate is evenly dispersed, then apply a thin, even coat across the surface to achieve full coverage. Avoid over-application. Once applied, allow 15–20 minutes drying time before tiling or applying levelling compounds.

result.description:
Achieving the look of real brick often means extra weight, structural preparation and uneven surfaces. Tatten's Red Brick colourway captures that familiar terracotta character in a porcelain format that installs cleanly and settles quickly into the look of true brickwork. The tile's generous size helps establish a clear brick layout, while its six varied faces prevent repetition so the wall develops a natural blend of tonal shifts and subtle surface detail.

The warm red tone brings an inviting depth once installed, giving the wall the classic presence of brick without the complexity of working with real masonry. The porcelain construction works equally well on indoor and outdoor walls. A 3mm grout joint keeps each brick clearly outlined for a convincing pattern, and we recommend a 10-12.5mm trim.

breadcrumbs.label: Everscape™ Marstone Silver Outdoor Tile (60cm x 90cm)

result.tile_care:
Everscape is a range of 20mm Porcelain tiles, which will require regular care and maintenance to retain that showroom finish. The specific initial cleaning requirement will depend on the fitting method used and choice of grouting options.

When fixing with Tile Adhesive and finishing with Micromax2 grouts:

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: Wait approximately 10 to 30 minutes after grouting and working in small areas, spray FILA Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean the surface using a damp sponge. For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat this process.

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila First Wash Extra Strong

Directions for use: Dilute FILA First Wash Extra Strong 1:5 with clean water (1 litre First Wash with 5 litres water). Spread the solution over the surface with a cloth and leave to act for 5 minutes. Wipe up any residues and rinse thoroughly with clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue. This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner. Always perform a test in a small portion of the surface to verify the acid resistance of the surface.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Tile & Stone Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute FILA Tile & Stone Cleaner 1:200 with clean water (3 capfuls with 5 litres water). Clean the tile surface using a cloth or mop. There is no need to rinse after cleaning as no residues are left on the surface.

For more stubborn dirt, dilute FILA Tile & Stone Cleaner 1:30 with clean water. Spread the solution evenly across the surface and leave to act for 5 minutes. Clean across the surface using a brush and rinse off with plenty of clean water

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Protector.

Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any remaining residues on the surface can be removed with Fila Tile & Stone Cleaner.


Any dry residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Tile & Stone Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

result.tile_care:
Everscape is a range of 20mm Porcelain tiles, which will require regular care and maintenance to retain that showroom finish. The specific initial cleaning requirement will depend on the fitting method used and choice of grouting options.

When fixing with Tile Adhesive and finishing with Micromax2 grouts:

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: Wait approximately 10 to 30 minutes after grouting and working in small areas, spray FILA Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean the surface using a damp sponge. For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat this process.

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila First Wash Extra Strong

Directions for use: Dilute FILA First Wash Extra Strong 1:5 with clean water (1 litre First Wash with 5 litres water). Spread the solution over the surface with a cloth and leave to act for 5 minutes. Wipe up any residues and rinse thoroughly with clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue. This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner. Always perform a test in a small portion of the surface to verify the acid resistance of the surface.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Tile & Stone Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute FILA Tile & Stone Cleaner 1:200 with clean water (3 capfuls with 5 litres water). Clean the tile surface using a cloth or mop. There is no need to rinse after cleaning as no residues are left on the surface.

For more stubborn dirt, dilute FILA Tile & Stone Cleaner 1:30 with clean water. Spread the solution evenly across the surface and leave to act for 5 minutes. Clean across the surface using a brush and rinse off with plenty of clean water

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Protector.

Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any remaining residues on the surface can be removed with Fila Tile & Stone Cleaner.


Any dry residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Tile & Stone Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

  • Moderate slip resistance.
  • 25-year domestic warranty.
